mapper.sql: task_id, parent_task_id, project_id, milestone_id, task_type_id, task_status_id, title, content, assignee_user_id, priority_code, progress_rate, start_date, due_date, estimated_hours, actual_hours, is_deleted, created_by, created_at, updated_at, est_start_date, est_end_date, attachment_group_id, editor_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.parent_task_id AS parentTaskId, t.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, t.title AS title, t.assignee_user_id AS assigneeUserId, u.user_name AS userName, t2.type_name AS typeName, t.progress_rate AS progressRate, t.actual_hours AS actualHours, t.start_date AS startDate, t.due_date AS dueDate FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN task_types t2 ON t.task_type_id = t2.task_type_id LEFT JOIN users u ON t.assignee_user_id = u.user_id
AND (t.project_id = #{projectId} OR p.parent_project_id = #{projectId})
AND ( t.title LIKE '%' || #{title} || '%' OR u.user_name LIKE '%' || #{title} || '%' OR t2.type_name LIKE '%' || #{title} || '%' )
AND t.assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}
AND t2.type_name = #{typeName}
AND t.start_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND t.due_date <= TO_DATE(#{dueDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY t.start_date DESC
